design.decision: Commit an honor to the first trick instead of feeling out the hand.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first trick; opponents spend an honor to contest it.
design.rationale: A broad ×1.5 (the first-trick condition fires about 57% of the time) that turns the first trick into a real decision. It is the ×multiplier version of cb-first-trick-mult (+8.4).
design.draftText: ×1.5 contract multiplier when your team wins the first trick of a round

history.note: draft-uncommon: merged into ub-first-trick-xmult, the same design (signature) from another cluster; the amount sweep decides the number.
